SELECT lu2.id AS userId, lu2.user_name AS userName, lu2.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, lu2.account AS userAccount FROM login_user lu JOIN user_friend uf ON (uf.user_id = lu.id OR uf.friend_id = lu.id) JOIN login_user lu2 ON ( (uf.user_id = lu.id AND uf.friend_id = lu2.id) OR (uf.friend_id = lu.id AND uf.user_id = lu2.id) ) WHERE lu.account = #{userAccount}

SELECT lu2.id AS userId, lu2.user_name AS userName, lu2.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, lu2.account AS userAccount FROM login_user lu JOIN user_friend uf ON (uf.user_id = lu.id OR uf.friend_id = lu.id) JOIN login_user lu2 ON ( (uf.user_id = lu.id AND uf.friend_id = lu2.id) OR (uf.friend_id = lu.id AND uf.user_id = lu2.id) ) WHERE lu.id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.friend_id ELSE uf.user_id END AS friendId, lu.user_name AS friendName, lu.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, lu.account AS friendAccount, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.remark_user_for_friend ELSE uf.remark_friend_for_user END AS remark FROM user_friend uf JOIN login_user lu ON ( uf.user_id = lu.id OR uf.friend_id = lu.id ) WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} OR uf.friend_id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.friend_id ELSE uf.user_id END AS friendId, lu.user_name AS friendName, lu.avatar_file_id AS avatarFileId, lu.account AS friendAccount, CASE WHEN uf.user_id = #{userId} THEN uf.remark_user_for_friend -- 作为user, remark_user_for_friend是他备注别人 ELSE uf.remark_friend_for_user -- 作为friend, remark_friend_for_user是他备注别人 END AS remark FROM user_friend uf JOIN login_user lu ON ( (uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.friend_id = lu.id) OR (uf.friend_id = #{userId} AND uf.user_id = lu.id) ) WHERE (uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.friend_id = #{friendId}) OR (uf.friend_id = #{userId} AND uf.user_id = #{friendId})
